2609.24504.title: On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging
2609.24504.paper_summary: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.
2609.24504.paper_summary_zh: 微調的檢查點和適配器現在充斥著公共庫，而對這些工件應用的最常見操作是模型合併：對它們的權重進行算術運算，以便廉價地組合能力。我們詢問這一操作對於新興能力的影響：工件所擁有的行為，這些行為從未是明確的訓練目標。通過研究兩個獨立的測試平台（激活神諭和新興不對齊模型）以及三個模型家族，我們發現答案是三方面的。首先，合併保留了兩個父母所擁有的新興能力：合併兩個不對齊的檢查點在整個混合範圍內保留了它們大部分的廣泛不對齊。其次，合併無法創造出在其父母中具有超加性的新興能力：兩個單任務神諭的加權合併無法達到共同訓練神諭的審計能力。第三，當只有一個父母擁有該能力時，合併的稀釋速度比隨之而來的訓練能力更快：在大多數情境中，這一差距是顯著的。簡而言之，工件的新興行為並不像其訓練能力那樣組合。
2609.24504.author: Luca Zhou et.al.
